name: wds_vtab-diabetic_retinopathy
description: wds_vtab-diabetic_retinopathy is an image classification benchmark derived from the VTAB-style diabetic retinopathy collection that measures models' ability to identify severity of diabetic retinopathy from retinal fundus images. It is used to evaluate visual representation learning and transfer performance on a medically focused vision task. The benchmark emphasizes robustness and generalization of image encoders to clinically relevant image features.
reputation: A niche medical imaging task drawn from VTAB-style benchmarks; moderately used in vision transfer learning and medical-imaging research communities.
